basics.label: Veterinarian and MS researcher in Microbiology
basics.summary: Research Assistant in the MTR Lab at Bangladesh Agricultural University, studying bacterial genomics and antimicrobial resistance. Seeking PhD opportunities in microbial genomics, bacterial evolution, and AMR.

education.summary: In progress. Department of Microbiology and Hygiene, Faculty of Veterinary Science. Thesis on molecular and phenotypic characterization of bacteria from horses and associated environments.

work.summary: Supervised by Prof. Dr. Md. Tanvir Rahman.
highlights: Bacterial whole-genome sequence analysis, AMR and virulence gene profiling, plasmid analysis, pangenomes, and SNP phylogeny.
Linux workflow development, data validation, figure preparation, and manuscript contributions.
Sample collection, bacterial culture, phenotypic characterization, and PCR.
